product.name: SMS Marketing
product.description: A service that enables businesses to send text messages to customers to drive sales and establish direct communication.

product.name: Email Marketing
product.description: A service that creates personalized email campaigns to increase sales and enhance customer lifetime value.

product.name: Reviews & UGC
product.description: A tool that collects and displays customer reviews and user-generated content on e-commerce sites using AI-driven displays and customizable galleries.

product.name: Loyalty & Referrals
product.description: A service that motivates customers with rewards and referral programs to encourage repeat purchases and brand advocacy.

product.name: Retention Management and Optimization
product.description: A platform that consolidates retention solutions to create tailored post-purchase customer journeys and track performance for optimization.
